answer: Money remembers where it came from, and a ballot's stake should too. Each $25 stake must trace its funding back 90 days on the public ledger, sharing no funder within two hops of another ballot — the check LayerZero ran to cut 803,093 wallets in 2024. Wallets fed by one hub form one cluster and cast one vote together. A farm seeding 10,000 wallets from one exchange account dies at that terrace: one hub, one cluster, one vote, $250,000 frozen behind it. Funding them legally takes 10,000 distinct sources aged 90 days — like a jade relic, provenance cannot be carved overnight.
